Commentary.Commentary: That brings us to the end of our coverage of this game. West Indies did compete but eventually, England proved too good for their opponents. The next match of the series is at the same venue on 5th March, 2017. The action begins at 0930 local, 1330 GMT. Do join us for that one. Till next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

EOIN MORGAN (MAN OF THE MATCH) attributes his recent good form to enjoying his cricket and batting with more freedom. Admits that the pitch was tough to bat early on and so he took his time before gradually playing his shots. Says that he and Stokes talked about getting their eye in first. Praises Billings for his valuable contribution. Says that Stokes was fit to bowl but the conditions didn't require his bowling. States the pitch was a bit uneven and shot making got tougher. Maintains that there are some areas to improve on and hopes his side can get it right in the next match.

JASON HOLDER feels that losing early wickets hurt West Indies and laments some soft dismissals as well. Feels that they could have done better with the ball and admits that the dropped chance of Morgan cost them big. Feels that it was important to get longer partnerships on this pitch but they couldn't maintain more of them. Praises Mohammed and Carter for their contributions. Ends by saying that there are positives and hopes that they can rectify the mistakes in the next game.

Plunkett and Woakes were brilliant, ending up with 4 wickets apiece. They were brilliant both with the new and old balls with good support from Finn. While the quicks were impressive, England's spinners couldn't create much of an impression. In the end, it was a relatively easy victory for the visitors. Early in the day, skipper Morgan's ton helped England post a daunting total with Stokes and Billings playing valuable knocks as well.

Comfortable win in the end for England as they go 1-0 up in the three-match ODI series. Chasing a stiff target of 297, West Indies' openers started with caution but then three wickets fell quickly to dent the chase. Hope and Mohammed repaired the innings a bit with a sensible partnership before the former departed. Mohammed batted on and found a valiant partner in Carter as the duo brought the chase alive with a fine stand. Once it was broken, the innings slowly folded up although Nurse played a few big shots at the death.

OUT! So that does it. West Indies have been bowled out. It's all over. Back of a length angling down, Shannon Gabriel looks to glance it fine down the leg side but can only manage to get some glove on it. Jos Buttler comes running in and takes a dolly. Appeals and the umpire eventually raises his finger. With this, ENGLAND WIN BY 45 RUNS!
Full delivery, it's driven through point for a single.
Liam Plunkett is back.
Takes the pace off this and bowls it on a good length, outside off, Gabriel is beaten by the lack of pace as he hangs his bat out to it.
Full toss again, Gabriel drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Low full toss on middle and off, hit back to the left of the bowler.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in.

OUT! He's dead plumb. Nurse's brief fightback has come to an end. Woakes angles in a full length ball on middle and leg, raps Ashley on the pads as he looks to flick it away. The umpire takes a moment but then eventually raises his finger to the leg before appeal. Nurse for the sake of it reviews the decision and replays also show him to be gone. The ball was clipping leg stump. England just need 1 wicket now to win.
Only an inside edge can save Nurse here.
Ashley Nurse has been adjudged out lbw decision. He has decided to review the decision, more out of optimism. Seems quite plumb.
SIX! He's launched that one out of here. What a hit! Full and outside off, in the slot as Nurse gets well under this. He smokes this straight back down the ground and gets a biggie to his name.
Spears in a full delivery just around off, Nurse off the inside half drives it to mid on.
FOUR! BOOM! Consecutive boundaries to end the over with. Fuller on the stumps, Bishoo slogs it right through the gap in the mid-wicket region. WI need 53 runs to win off 24 deliveries.
FOUR! Devendra Bishoo sending one across. It's on a back of a length, Bishoo hangs back and pulls it over mid-wicket comfortably. Nobody out there in the deep and that will run away across the fence.
Short of a length outside off, Ashley Nurse drags the pull to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Pounded in short outside off, Nurse lofts it down towards third man. It falls well short of the fielder there and the batsmen take a run.
Slants it across the left-hander, on a fullish length, he reaches out to it and steers it down to third man for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven to long on for a single and that will be the end of the over.
In the air.... but safe! Fuller outside off, Nurse goes for the big slog once more but gets a huge top edge. It however falls safely behind the stumps as nobody could come under it. One run taken.
SIX! Ashley Nurse giving just what the doctor ordered. Full around off, Nurse gets low and slogs it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Really got hold of that one.
Devendra Bishoo is the next man in.

OUT! Length delivery outside off, Carlos Brathwaite clears his front leg to go big over long on, but ends up getting a big top edge which balloons to extra cover. Joe Root is the man there and he takes a good, safe catch. The end is nigh for West Indies.
Bowls it marginally ahead of a length, it's flicked straight to the mid-wicket fielder who is standing right at the edge of the circle.
Back of a length delivery very close to the off pole, Ashley Nurse mistimes his pull shot through mid-wicket. Gets a single for it.
Chris Woakes has a change of ends.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Ashley Nurse pushes it through to sweeper cover. Ends the over with a single.
Settling for singles here. Carlos punches it back down the ground to long on for one more run.
Short and hurled on the pads, comfortably flicked through backward square leg for a single.
Fires in an accurate yorker on middle stump, it's dug out to the covers.
Uses the pace of the ball and guides this shortish delivery to third man for a single.
FOUR! BANG! Stand and deliver stuff from Carlos Brathwaite. Shortish around off, he stands tall and swats it through the line over mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length around off, Carlos Brathwaite drags the pull through square leg. The man in the deep cleans it up as a single is taken.
Fires it up there, it's driven through to long off for a single.
Just short of a length, outside off, crunched straight to the point fielder off the back foot.
Moving back in ever so slightly, Nurse looking to push it away is cut in two as the ball goes right between bat and pad.
Good length delivery outside off, Nurse drives it through the covers for a couple of runs.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Ashley Nurse is the new man in.

OUT! He's gone. Casual running has done him in. The big fish Mohammed has to pay the price for that and now, makes the long walk back. Carlos defends a short ball on the leg side and calls for the run. Mohammed is running in a rather sloppy manner as Finn also charges to the ball. He kicks it on to the stumps and the decision is taken upstairs. Replays show Jason Mohammed's bat was just out of the crease and he's out. West Indies need 87 off 48.
A run out appeal against Jason Mohammed is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Shortish delivery and it's pulled through to deep mid-wicket. One run taken.
Back of a length outside off, pushed a bit square on the off side for another run.
On a back of a length, around off, it's pulled down to long on for one more. The Windies need some boundaries here. The singles aren't going to hurt England.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Carlos Brathwaite drops it in front of backward point for one.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, easily worked down to long on for a run.
Straightening up on a length outside off, dabbed to point for a single.

Risky stuff. Carlos works it in front of short mid-wicket and sets off. Stokes there runs to the ball and throws it at the bowler's end behind through his legs, and almost gets his man too. Close call.
Another length delivery in the off stump channel, angled to third man once more for another single.
Tad fullish in length, well outside off, it's run down to third man by Carlos Brathwaite and he's off the mark with a single.
Carlos Brathwaite is the new man in.

OUT! Edged and taken! The West Indies skipper is gone. Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, Jason Holder looks to run it down to third man but ends up getting a faint tickle behind. Jos Buttler takes a regulation catch and that's another wicket down for the hosts. Holder had begun to walk even before the umpire's finger went up. WI need 96 to win off 58 balls.
Fuller length delivery around off, Holder gets big on the ball and drives it to the covers.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the ring.
Fuller on middle and leg, gets across and works it to mid on for a single.
Back of a length around off, gets back and pats it back to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks well.
Shortish on middle, gets across and clips it deftly down towards fine leg for a brace.
Shortish on off, another one-legged pull towards long leg for a single.
Good length on off, worked gently towards the leg side for a single.
Steven Finn is back on to bowl.
Shortish on middle and leg, uppish pull towards long leg but it falls safe. A couple taken.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and wide outside off, Mohammed sits on the back foot and cuts it away through point to find the fence. Found the gap with precision.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends well.
Shortish outside off, stays back and taps it towards backward point.
Jason Holder is the new man in.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Superb stuff from Roy! Shortish around leg, Carter backs away and plays the pull but gets a top edge towards deep mid-wicket. Roy comes forward and takes a superb low catch diving forward. Superb fielding and this is a massive wicket as Carter was looking ominous. WI need 107 from 70 balls.
Speared well down the leg side, Carter cannot get any bat on it. Wide called.
Back of a length on middle, Mohammed is pinged on the pad. Huge lbw appeal but turned down. Maybe a bit high. Was there an inside edge? A leg bye taken.
Back of a length on middle, gets back to flick but is struck high on the pads. They go for a leg bye.
Full and wide outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a single.
Shortish outside off, stays back and slaps it through cover for a single.
Once again Woakes tests the midpoint of the pitch and Mohammed this time connects the pull. Not timed that well but aerially gets it over mid-wicket to the deep for a couple.
Short of a length on middle, Mohammed backs away to pull it away but misses.
Back of a length on off, stays back to that one and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Drinks are on the field...
On middle and leg, Mohammed tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed gently towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Carter looks to pull but gets a bottom edge that goes on the bounce towards the right of Buttler. Single taken.

FOUR! Superb shot! Back of a length around leg stump, gets across to that one and whips it away. More of a pick up shot and gets it well wide of the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. What a knock it has been from the young man! His 3rd ODI fifty.
Back of a length outside off, cut away towards third man for a single.
Wide! Short of a length down the leg side, Mohammed looks to swing it away but misses. Wide called.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Liam Plunkett is back on.
Good length outside off, Mohammed tries to cut it away but is beaten. No real room for that kind of shot.
Slower ball outside off, stays back and slices the cut down to third man for a single.
Good running! Shortish outside off, Carter stays tall and cuts it through point. Positive running gets them the second run although he had to really hurry.
Full and wide outside off, Carter reaches it and slices it towards point. Just short of the fielder.
That ball has gone and the fourth umpire has come out with a set of replacement balls for his on-field mates to choose from.
SIX! THAT'S OUT OF THE GROUND! Carter is looking deadly at the moment. Short ball and he picks up nicely with a meaty pull over deep square leg for a huge maximum. What a hit! Sheer power!
Shortish outside off, gets back to punch it but ends up slicing to point for a single.
Chris Woakes is back.
Floated outside off, Mohammed gets across to sweep but is struck on the pads. A leg bye taken.
Floated on off, Carter gets across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Loopy around leg stump, misses the sweep and is struck on the pads. Lbw appeal but it pitched outside leg.
Floated outside off, defends it solidly off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, stays back and guides it to short third man for a single.
Floated around leg stump, Mohammed goes for the sweep but is struck on the pads. Muted and optimistic shout for lbw, turned down.
50-run stand between Mohammed and Carter!

FOUR! Nicely done! Flatter around off, Carter plays the reverse lob over point. Made fairly decent contact as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. This partnerships is gathering momentum all of a sudden.
Fuller and outside off, driven firmly through the covers for a brace.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Drifting in from around off, charges down the track and belts it mercilessly over long on for a mammoth maximum. Clean strike!
Flighted outside off, steps out and drives it to deep cover for a couple.

NOT OUT! Floated outside off, Carter drives and it goes straight back at Root who takes it. Appeal for catch and the umpires want to check it upstairs. Replays confirm that the ball clearly bounced after making contact with the bat.
An appeal for a catch against Jonathan Carter is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Floated around off, gets across to sweep but gets a soft top edge on it towards the short leg region that is vacant.
Fuller and around off, gets across to that one and plays the reverse sweep through cover for a single.
Floated on middle, gets well across the stumps and plays a premeditated paddle down to fine leg for a brace.
The sweeps keep coming. Floated on off, gets across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a run.
Fuller around off, leans across and sweeps it away on the leg side for a single.
On a length outside off, Carter gets back and dabs it gently past point for a couple.
Flighted around off, leans across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Drifting in from around off, tries the reverse sweep but finds short third man.
Full on off, Mohammed sweeps it through square leg for a single.
On a length around off, defends it well from the crease.
Maiden ODI fifty for Jason Mohammed!
Flighted around leg stump, Mohammed gets across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a couple. It's been a fine knock.
Floated around off, gets across to sweep but gets it off the inner half past backward square leg for a single.
Darted outside off, stays back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated outside off, leans into it to play the late dab to third man but is hit on the pads. They get a leg bye.
Googly outside off, swept away through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Streaky runs! On a length outside off, stays back to cut but gets a thick bottom edge that rolls well wide of the slip fielder towards the third man fence for a boundary.

How close was that? Floated around off, spins in sharply, Carter shapes for the cut as the ball just whizzes past the off pole. Buttler collects it well and there is a big delayed appeal for caught behind but turned down. Rashid seems disappointed.
FOUR! Drifting in from around off, Carter gets across to that one and sweeps it hard to the deep square leg fence for a boundary. Nicely struck.
Floated around leg stump, swept away through backward square leg for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. Two runs added to the total.
Outside off, played to point. No run taken.
Sliding in from around off, it catches Carter on the pads. Stifled appeal for a leg before but it's turned down.
Turning away from around off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Some amount of dip on offer for Joe Root, around off as Jonathan Carter drives it to the cover region.
Flatter ball around off, sliding in, kept out off the back foot.
Joe Root is back.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Straighter one around off, goes off the outside edge of Carter's bat as he pokes at it. Goes behind and just wide of Root at first slip. Single taken.
Googly around off, Carter is playing for the leg break but the ball goes the other way and it beats the outside edge of the bat.
Loopy and full on middle and leg, swept behind square on the leg side. Dot ball.
Half-tracker on the stumps, pulled away to deep mid-wicket. One run taken.
Straighter one from Adil Rashid, around off, Jason plays it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Fuller on middle and leg, it's swept away nicely through square leg for one more. That will be the end of the over.
Darts this full and flat, outside off, driven to covers for no run.
FOUR! In the slot and he's hit straight through the line. Full outside off, Mohammed stands firm and just lofts it over extra cover to send it all the way for a boundary. Nicely done.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Serves this on the pads, it's nudged round the corner off the back foot for an easy single.
Floated on the stumps, a little straight as Jason plays it down in front of his pads.
Quicker one on the stumps, takes the inside edge and falls on the track on his attempt block.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Loopy full delivery on off, driven back down to long off for a single.
Bowls this full on leg, Jonathan kneels to sweep but it hits him somewhere. Hence, no wide called.
Leg break on middle and leg, swept away to the square leg region for a single.
Slider on the stumps, Jason Mohammed stays back to make sure it's kept out.
Shorter in length, just around off, punched away to the cover area off the back foot.
Drifting in on a fullish length, on middle and off, it's worked to mid-wicket.
Pushed slightly quicker through the air, around off, defended off the outer half on the off side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Similar ball, same result, it's driven to the extra cover fielder.
Looped up just outside off, Mohammed with a front foot push to the extra cover fielder.
Floats this up on off, Jonathan Carter leans into it and drives it straight back to Adil Rashid.
Full and darted outside off, Carter brings out the reverse sweep but misses to connect completely.
Tosses it right up there, on middle, Carter sweeps it straight to backward square leg.

OUT! Rashid gets his man! Loopy ball outside off, Shai Hope goes deep inside his crease and looks to cut it away. It goes off the outer half and bobbles straight towards Steven Finn at short third man who dives low forward to take a good catch. A solid partnership has come to an end.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, it's pushed in front of covers for nothing.
Flighted outside off, driven to long off for a couple of runs. Hit it wide of the fielder and so, the second run became available.
FOUR! Two in two now. It's full on the stumps, Jason Mohammed leans ahead a touch and flicks it nicely over the mid-wicket region for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Sliding across the batsman, Mohammed backs away and cuts it past the diving backward point fielder to get a boundary.
Flighted outside off, driven towards covers where Eoin Morgan makes a good diving save. Led with the bat earlier and is now leading by example in the field as well.

NOT OUT! Jason Mohammed survives! Tossed up from around the wicket, Moeen Ali drops it on middle and leg, it's turning and raps Mohammed on the front pad. There are loud appeals for a leg before which are turned down. England however review the decision and replays show that the ball would have missing the leg stump. So the decision stays.
England have taken a review for lbw against Mohammed. Looked a bit marginal but where it pitched will be the main question.
Continues from around the wicket, it's floated around leg, flicked away on the leg side.
Short and flat, punched to long on for a run. That'll be the end of the over.
Lovely flighted delivery outside off, Jason Mohammed manages to work this towards the third man region and get two runs for doing so.
Short, flat and turning away a touch from the batsman, it's played back down the track into the hands of the bowler.
Skidding off the surface, on a bit of a fuller length, it's punched towards mid off for a single.
Loopy and fullish in length, on the pads though and hence it's turned to square leg for no run.
Tossed up on off, Hope with a tame push to the covers.
Loopy on the pads, comfortably nudged away to backward square leg for one run.
Tossed up ball on the stumps, driven to long on for an easy run.
Comes from around the wicket and darts it across Jason Mohammed, he tries to push it from inside the line but is beaten.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Stays on his back foot and whips it through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a shorter length, outside off, Mohammed backs away and punches it straight to the cover fielder.
50-run stand between Hope and Mohammed.
Short and wide outside off, Hope makes a little room and cuts it square on the off side. Two runs taken.
Too full and going down leg, swept straight to short fine leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Turning a bit on a flatter trajectory, it's worked to mid-wicket for a run.
Short, flat and on the body, it's pulled through backward square leg for one.
Full and on off, leans across and nudges it deftly through mid-wicket for a brace.
Flatter around leg stump, Hope plays the pull-sweep through backward square leg for a single.
Slider outside off, sits back to that one and blocks well.
Fuller outside off, driven down the ground to long on for a single.

FOUR! Yes it has! Flatter outside off, Mohammed stays back and powers it through the covers to the deep. Billings makes a sliding stop in the deep. They go upstairs to see if his foot was touching the rope while gathering the ball and it was indeed the case. Another boundary.
They are going upstairs to check for a boundary. Has Billings' foot touched the rope?
FOUR! Wrong line and punished! Fired well down the leg side, Mohammed capitalizes on the offering and sweeps it away past short fine leg for a boundary. Easy pickings!
Floated around off, gets back and whips it towards mid-wicket.
Slider on middle and leg, gets back and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Lovely leg break on middle, nicely bowled and Mohammed does well to block.
Wide! Rashid isn't getting his radar right at all, spears another down the leg side and that shall be a wide again.
Another ball down the leg side by Rashid, Mohammed sweeps but cannot beat short fine leg. Missed out there.
Drifting in on middle, nicely blocked off the front foot by Mohammed.
Flatter on middle and leg, stays back and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball! Once again drifting down the leg side and Hope controls the sweep well to pick up a boundary at fine leg. Not a great start for the leg spinner.
Wide! Starts with a loosener down the leg side, left alone and wide called.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack.
Drinks break....
Flighted on the stumps, Mohammed gets across and clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Loopy on a length around off, spinning in, stays back and blocks it well.
Loopy and full outside off, pushed gently towards the cover region.
Drifting on the pads, Hope clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, Mohammed stays back and eases it to long on for a single.
Tossed up wider outside off, driven towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good length on middle, stays back and defends it towards mid on.
Slips it down the leg side, Mohammed looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and pushes it towards cover.

Full and outside off, driven firmly towards extra cover for a quick single. Direct hit at the bowler's end but Hope was well in. He had gone well past the crease and the batsmen couldn't take the second run off the overthrow.
Short of a length on middle, stays back and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Good length on middle, gets back and works it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, stays back to that one and blocks it towards extra cover.
Flatter on off, sits back and powers it down the ground to long on for a single.
Full and around off, pushed gently back to the bowler.
Lovely ball! Drifting in from outside off, Mohammed looks to drive but is beaten totally. Extra bounce on that one.
Flatter outside off, sits back to cut but gets a bottom edge on it.
Flatter outside off, stays back and powers it to long on for a single.
Flighted outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Moeen Ali is introduced into the bowling attack.
On middle and leg, clipped gently towards mid-wicket.
Root comes to first slip.
Straying on the pads, Hope chips it uppishly down to fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, walks across and works it through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Beautiful stroke! Fuller ball outside off, leans into it and times the drive sweetly past mid off. Didn't try to overhit it, just eased it away.
Shortish outside off, gets back and blocks it well.
On middle and leg, gets across and works it to the leg side.
Shortish outside off, Hope mistimes the pull to the right of the mid on fielder for a single.
Full and on the pads, gets across and clips it uppishly down to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Shortish outside off, sits back and slaps it through point. Struck really well and that races away to the fence for a boundary. Got on top of the bounce nicely and stroked it away fluently.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
On middle and leg, Hope tucks it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, sits back and blocks it to cover-point for a single.
Nice stroke! Shortish outside off, sits back and punches it through the covers for a couple.
Full and angling in from around off, pushed gently towards the mid on region.
Good length ball around off, gets across and taps it towards square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, rocks back and defends it well.
Good length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards the cover region.
Short of a length outside off, stays back and runs it down to third man for a single.
Good length on off, gets across to that one and pats it back to the bowler.
Fuller and around off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Jason Mohammed is the next batsman in.

OUT! Woakes has another! The West Indies are imploding here. Back of a length outside off, sticks a bit off the surface as Brathwaite plays across the line to pull but gets a top edge that bobbles to mid on where Rashid takes a fairly simple catch. England firmly on top at this stage.
Shortish outside off, Hope steers it down to third man for a single.
Length ball angled in around off, gets back and blocks well.
Back of a length outside off, cut away down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and blocks solidly.
Good length outside off, rocks back and blocks well.
Full and outside off, crisply driven to the mid off region.
Good length outside off, stays back and makes a leave to that one.
Shai Hope walks into the middle next to bat.

OUT! PLUNKETT STRIKES! Sad comeback for Powell in ODIs. Back of a length ball around off, he is early into the flick and gets a leading edge that lobs straight towards Roy at point. Suddenly, the West Indies innings has hit a roadblock. Just the start Plunkett would have wanted  as he is an impact bowler.

Length ball outside off, punched firmly towards point where Roy makes a fine stop but ends up firing a wayward off balance throw. Buttler does well to collect it as otherwise it could have been overthrows. Smiles all around.
Liam Plunkett comes on to bowl.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the ring.
Tailing back in on a back of a length, on the stumps, raps Kraigg on the thigh pad. The lbw appeal is turned down as height is an issue.
Fuller in length, worked away to mid-wicket by Powell for a single. He's off the mark.
Speared full and it's driven back down towards mid off.
Fuller length delivery outside off, it's driven a bit square on the off side by Kieran Powell. No run taken.
Kieran Powell is the new man in.

OUT! WOAKES STRIKES UPON HIS RETURN! The bowling change does the trick. A poor shot though from the southpaw as he'll feel he should have done better. He wasn't middling the ball well at all and his frustration seems to have got the better of him. Length ball around off, cutter from Chris, Lewis gets under it and pulls it over square leg. The elevation isn't there, neither is the distance and it flies straight into the hands of Sam Billings out in the deep. West Indies lose their first wicket.
Short of a length around off, it's punched back down the track in the direction of the bowler.
Chris Woakes is back on to bowl.
On a shorter length, on middle and off, pulled away to backward square leg. One run added to the scoreboard.
Fuller length delivery just around off, Lewis drives this really hard. Hits it square towards cover-point where the fielder makes a diving save.
Pounds this on a shorter length, Evin Lewis stands his ground and punches it straight to the extra cover fielder. He's trying to pierce the gap in that area but is just not able to.
Short of a length outside off, with an angled bat it's steered past point for a comfortable run.
On a good length, just around off, played back down the track for no run.
Length delivery just around off, it straightens up after hitting the deck, Kraigg is squared up as he plays this off the outer half to backward point.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Darts it full and it's going down leg, wide called.
Flighted delivery from Joe Root, it's eased back down to long off for a run.
Full outside off, pushed off the front foot on the off side.
Tossed up around off, it's drifting in as Lewis lofts it over the covers. It's a big boundary out there which allows Plunkett to come across from long off and cut it off. A brace taken.
Darts it full outside off, driven hard straight to extra cover.
Floats this up outside off, some drift and dip for Root, Lewis walks across and nudges it to short fine leg.
Again gets it off the inner half. Kraigg with a pull shot which goes straight to the square leg fielder.
Length delivery just around off, off the inner half Kraigg defends it down on the track on the on side.
On a shortish length, it's pulled away in front of square for an easy run.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Lewis gets right behind the line and pushes it out with the full face of the bat.

That's in the air and the catch has been taken as well, but to no avail. There was no bat involved. Back of a length angling across, Lewis looks to pull but it lobs off the thigh pad behind to Root at first slip.
Quite straight from Steven Finn, on middle and leg, worked square on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, driven straight to the short extra cover fielder.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
'Round the wicket, on off, flicked to mid-wicket for a run.
Switches the angle again, it's on middle and leg, Kraigg turns this towards backward square leg and both batsman set off, a bit risky but comfortably done in the end. Single taken.
Comes around the wicket to Evin Lewis, darts it full and it's coming in on the pads, worked away easily on the on side for one more.
Full and flat on the stumps, it's flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Well, well... What do we have here? Surprisingly, Joe Root will have a go with the ball. Not sure what the plan is behind that. However, he has a slip positioned for Kraigg Brathwaite.
Arrows this full on the pads, no trouble for the batsman to flick it through backward square leg for a single.
Serves it nicely on a length, on middle and off, Lewis works it in front of square. It's through the gap as a single is taken.
Around off, KB walks across and turns it square on the leg side for an easy run.
Good length delivery just around off, Kraigg Brathwaite plays it back down the track aerially but it's quite away from the bowler.
Full on off, swinging away at the very last second, forces Kraigg to square up as the ball goes off the splice towards point.
Back of a length outside off, Kraigg Brathwaite positions himself behind the line and punches it towards extra cover.
Short of a length, outside off, pushed away a bit square on the off side to end the over.
Back of a length delivery, at a good pace it's pitched on off, Lewis walks across to flick but gets it off the thigh pad. It lobs over on the off side for no run.
Shaping away, on a length, it's tapped gently on the off side off the back foot.
Solid in defense as Evin Lewis walks a step across to this length ball. Presents the full face of the bat and punches it back down the track.
Back of a length, on off, the left-hander swivels across to pull but misses and the ball goes off the hips behind on the off side.
Connects well but it's straight to the fielder. Lewis will be kicking himself for missing out. Speared very full and outside off, Lewis firmly drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Finn hurls this on a good length on middle and leg, Kraigg closes the face and works it in front of the mid-wicket fielder. Dot ball to end the over.
Bit fullish in length, shaping back in on middle and leg, flicked to the mid-wicket region for a run.
FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! Full delivery outside off, a half-volley for Lewis as he walks across to this one. Hammers the drive through the covers and sends it across the rope for a boundary.
Bangs it in short, on the body, it's nudged fine down the leg side for a single.
Coming back in on middle and off, Lewis works it towards mid-wicket and runs through to complete the single.
Length delivery outside off, Evin stands tall and offers a solid punch in front of covers.
Length ball outside off, well outside off actually, Lewis plays it off the outer half down to third man for one run.

FOUR! Connects better on this occasion and he puts it away. Short of a length around off, Evin Lewis swivels a bit and pulls it past the square leg region. The chasing fielder has no chance to stop and hence, the left-hander will get a boundary to his name.
On the shorter side of a length, slanting across, it's pulled off the inside half on the leg side.
Uppish from Evin Lewis but it's well in the gap. Fired in full outside off, Lewis drives this through the gap in the covers and picks up a couple of runs.
Some inward movement for Woakes as it's pitched on a back of a length, just around off, Lewis hops across to play but is hit on the thigh pad.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery and angles it across Evin Lewis, the southpaw goes deep inside his crease and lets it be.
Chris Woakes will bowl from the other end with the second new ball. Two slips for him as well.
Tailing back in on middle and leg, wristed to the square leg fielder for no run and that will be the end of the over.
Shortish delivery pounded in hard, on off, the batsman meets it with a straight blade.
Hurls this just back of a length, around off, it's kept out from deep inside the crease.
FOUR! Overpitched and too straight and Kraigg Brathwaite deals with it nicely. He flicks it ever so well through the square leg region for a boundary.
On a good length once more, in the channel outside off, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.
Wide! Well outside off on a good length, Kraigg leaves it alone. No trouble in doing so.
Starts off with a straight delivery, Kraigg Brathwaite turns it towards the square leg fielder.

Welcome back for the chase. A solid start is imperative for the West Indies. Evin Lewis and Kraigg Brathwaite to open the batting. Steven Finn to take the new ball first up for England. He has two slips in place...
